svg.title: Eight-rank expert-parallel training
svg.desc: A conceptual training step across eight ranks, with eight local minibatches queued per rank. Each rank has replicated projection and router layers and owns one expert. Forward and backward all-to-all exchanges move token assignments and gradients, replicated parameter gradients are all-reduced, expert parameter gradients stay on their owner, and Adam updates the parameters.
svg.text: Conceptual: eight experts, one per rank. Each rank queues eight local minibatches; the path shows one step, repeated for each minibatch.
